title: Stored null matter carried from Node Beta to the Central Nexus bid at 200 cr or more
note: 2026-11-17 19:41 UTC (Mercury, written by sellgen.py, orders.log ENT-042 block MERCURY, rule F24). Traders store 714 at Node Beta (the tool stock, 19:34 UTC); the fleet 2,629 there. Zero's carry-null-matter-synchrony-nexus serves Synchrony Hub's 2,108 with one ship. Central Nexus bid null matter 200 x 7 (17:56 UTC), 200 x 45 (18:05), 210 x 95 (19:09), 200 x 295 (19:14), 210 x 38 (19:20), 200 x 104 (19:38) and 0 at 19:40 UTC (ledger.py prices null_matter): a bid that comes back within minutes; it is the only null matter bid in our 40 books. Central Nexus asks 213 to 220 cr (213 x 16 at 19:40 UTC, 220 x 278 before), so 200 is the spread below the market's ask, not a dump; the catalog's base value is 450, and no book bids near it. Null matter is in no target of game/reserve.tsv (surplus.py, 19:32 UTC; reservecheck.py PASS); it is size 2, so a hold of 65 carries 32. It goes into processed null matter only in a facility we do not own (process_null_matter). A test: max_ships 1, no lift_to, until its first RESULT line is read (rules F8, F13 of the rulebook; my lesson on lift_to).
